title: Ukanushaji (Theme 11: Uwekezaji)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child changes the person to its negative (ni- si-, a- ha-, wa- hawa-) and the tense to its negative form (-na- to -i ending, -li- to -ku-, -me- to -ja-, -ta- stays).
representations: a negation table by person and tense
colour for person and tense parts

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Sijalipa" and the negatives of "Ninalipa" and "Nililipa".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: "Ninasoma kitabu."" Kwa nini "Si ninasoma kitabu." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kitenzi kinakanushwa kwa kubadili kiambishi cha mtu na wakati ndani yake, si kwa kuweka "si" mbele. Ninasoma - sisomi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: "Amesoma kitabu."" Kwa nini "Hamesoma kitabu." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Katika ukanusho, -me- hubadilika kuwa -ja-: amesoma - hajasoma. -li- hubadilika kuwa -ku-: alisoma - hakusoma.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: "Tutasoma kesho."" Kwa nini "Tusitasoma kesho." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Viambishi vya nafsi hubadilika katika ukanusho: ni- - si-, u- - hu-, a- - ha-, tu- - hatu-, m- - ham-, wa- - hawa-.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: "Anasoma kitabu."" Kwa nini "Hanasoma kitabu." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wakati uliopo hukanushwa bila -na-, na kitenzi humalizika kwa -i: anasoma - hasomi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kanusha: "Amesoma kitabu."" Kwa nini "Hasomi kitabu." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Ukanusho wa kila wakati una kiambishi chake: -na- hukanushwa bila kiambishi (hasomi), -me- huwa -ja- (hajasoma), -li- huwa -ku- (hakusoma), -ta- hubaki -ta- (hatasoma).
